en: Ah, there you are! The Slowpoke are safe and Team Rocket are gone, all thanks to you.
I make Poké Balls, you know, from Apricorns. Here, take this one. It's one of my own.
A Lure Ball is just the thing for a Pokémon you've hooked with a rod. Bring me Apricorns and I'll make you more.
Hm? A trainer? I make Poké Balls, the old way, from Apricorns. But I've no heart for it today.
Team Rocket are down in the Slowpoke Well, cutting off the Slowpoke's tails to sell! I won't stand for it.
I'll give those thugs a piece of my mind myself. Stand aside!
Bring me Apricorns and I'll turn them into Poké Balls. Every colour makes a ball of its own.
Grandpa's been grumpy all morning. He keeps looking out of the window at the well.
Grandpa ran off to the well. He said he'd sort out Team Rocket on his own. I hope he's all right...
The Slowpoke are home again! Grandpa says he'll get back to making Poké Balls now.
